senses.gloss: (denom. of מֶזֶג; b. h. to mix wine with water, spices &c.; to temper; in gen. to fill the cups, to offer drink.
units: Ab. Zar. 58ᵇ (to one who used מְסָכוֹ) ואימא מְזָגוֹ why do you not say m’zago? Ib. יין שמזגו נכרי wine which a gentile mixed for drinking.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 59a:5">Ib. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>חמרא דמָזְגוּ נכרים וכ׳</he> wine which gentiles mixed and Jews drank.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:2">Pes. X, 2</cite> <he>מזגו לו כוס וכ׳</he> they (the attendants) offer him the first cup &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1">Num. R. s. 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 7:3">Cant. VII, 3</cite>) <he>מי שהוא מוֹזֵג … מוֹזֵג וכ׳</he> (not <he>מזוג</he>) he who mixes wine properly, mixes one third wine with two thirds water; Tanḥ. B’midb. 4.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:13">Pes. VII, 13</cite> <he>לִמְזוֹג</he> to serve the wine; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00733"><he>מָזוּנ</he></cite>
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:2">Neg. I, 2</cite> <he>כיין המ׳ בשלג</he> the color of red wine mixed with snow, v. <cite ref="Q02176"><he>פָּתַךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:6">Nidd. II, 6</cite> <he>כמ׳</he> like mixed wine; expl.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:7">ib. 7</cite> <he>שני חלקים וכ׳</he> two thirds water &c., v. supra; <cite ref="Shabbat 75a">Sabb. 75ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2">Num. R. s. 2</cite>, beg. <he>בי״ח מקומות … מְזוּגִין</he> in eighteen biblical passages are Moses and Aaron combined (the predicate being in the singular number as if they were one person).
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be mixed. Y. Ab. Zar. V, 45ᵃ bot. אפי׳ נ׳ כל צרכו וכ׳ even if the quantity finally added to produce the required proportion was a permitted substance; Y. Orl. II, 62ᵇ bot.
to clarify, make clear. Cant. R. to VII, 4 (play on מזג, ib.) the Sanhedrin שהוא מְמַוֵּג וכ׳ which makes the law clear for her (the congregation).
